simple.summary: עֲנָה (ʻănâh) means poor. First listed occurrence: Dan 4 24.

definitions.full: H6033. anah [ עֲנָי K § 57 a ) β ) Str, or עֲנֵה compare Buhl, M] adjective poor, needy ; — plural absolute עֲנָי֑ן (Bear Gi K l.c .), or עֲנָ֑יִן (van d. H. Buhl M 77 *; compare D § 39, 1 ) as noun Dan 4:24 the poor .
